Moriuji"So you were an Emishi woman... With those robes, very neatly you had hidden it."
Moriuji"But now that you have shown yourself, what exactly can you do?"
Muramasa"What do you think?"
Muramasa"Cross swords with your great treasure there. That Higekiri tsurugi, yes, that one."
Moriuji"..."
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"...Oye, Mido! That fellow's face I can understand. Why are YOU also looking at me like 'what bakwaas is this woman talking'?!"
Kageaki"S-sorry. My eyes are reporting a woman. The armour part is still not getting through—"
Muramasa"Bas, stop that nonsense. Come on, Armoring Stance!"

en.html:
A strange relief came over me. I gave a crooked smile.

Only after armoring up did I understand.

...Nothing had changed about Muramasa.

My tsurugi. Same as before.

All this confusion, this worrying—my eyes had seen a different exterior and dragged the whole brain after them. No need for any of it.
